headline: Turkey's Central Bank Pauses Repo Auctions and Raises Lira Reserve Remuneration
summary: The Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey temporarily suspended its one-week repo auctions and raised the interest rate paid on Turkish lira reserve requirements.
why: Central bank liquidity adjustments directly impact short-term borrowing costs, banking sector margins, and currency stability in emerging markets.

entities.name: Central Bank of the Republic of Turkey

impacts.name: Turkish Lira
impacts.why: Altering reserve remuneration and suspending repo auctions changes domestic liquidity conditions and currency dynamics.

why_moved: Liquidity tightening measures by the central bank alter borrowing conditions and yield expectations for domestic financial assets.
